title: Junior QC engineer
description:
**Company**

Ishitva aims at solving one of the biggest challenges faced by the world currently, which is sorting and recycling of Plastic and other Dry Waste. We build automation solutions for waste management industry using industry 4.0 tools, including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and IoT. Our solutions use computer vision to make sorting of waste more efficient at different stages of the waste value chain. With a futuristic vision of revolutionising the recycling industry, today we provide solutions for automated picking, sorting, and segregation of dry waste including plastics.

Ishitva is recognised as top 10 leading AI based start-ups in the country and we are looking to build a team of young and energetic members who will work towards creating innovative solutions for some of the most urgent and important issues faced by the world. We are building a diverse team of professionals, engineers and environment enthusiasts to help us  
transform the waste management practices across the country.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Inward Quality Inspection:** Conduct quality inspections of incoming machine parts, purchased components, and materials to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications.

**Vendor Site Inspection:** Perform inspections at vendor locations to verify product quality, manufacturing processes, and adherence to company requirements.

**Instrument Calibration Management:** Maintain calibration records of measuring instruments and equipment, ensuring timely calibration and compliance with quality standards.

**ERP Management & Reporting:** Maintain accurate inward material transactions in the ERP system, update inspection records, and prepare quality-related reports.

**ISO Documentation & Compliance:** Maintain and update ISO-related documentation, quality records, and procedures to ensure compliance with established quality management standards.

**Process Improvement Coordination:** Coordinate with internal departments and vendors to identify quality issues, implement corrective and preventive actions, and support continuous process improvement initiatives.

**Requirements of a successful candidate**

· Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant mechanical background.

· Hands-on experience in using measuring instruments such as Vernier Calipers, Micrometers, Height Gauges, etc.

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and evaluate quality issues.

· Knowledge of quality inspection procedures and process improvement techniques.

· Ability to identify areas for improvement and contribute to continuous quality and process enhancement.

· Good attention to detail, accuracy, and coordination skills.

**Benefits**

Pick-up Drop facility from office to plant

Accident Insurance

Pay: From ₹350,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Manager - Technical Bid & Solution**
======================================

**Role:**
=========

This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.

**Technical RFP Analysis**
==========================

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

**Solution Shaping**
====================

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

**Estimation & Delivery Planning**
==================================

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

**Technical Proposal Development**
==================================

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

**Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity**
==================================================

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

**Reusable Solution Assets**
============================

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Head of Delivery
description:
- Description

  The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

  You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

  Responsibilities

  **Portfolio and P&L**

  * Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.
  * Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.
  * Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.
  * Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

  **Delivery operating model**

  * Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.
  * Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.
  * Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.
  * Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

  **Client delivery governance**

  * Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.
  * Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.
  * Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

  **Pre-sales support**

  * Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.
  * Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

  **People and leadership**

  * Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.
  * Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.
  * Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

  **Quality and compliance**

  * Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.
  * Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

  Required Skills

  * 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.
  * Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.\
  * Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.
  * Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.
  * Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.
  * Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.
  * Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.
  * Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.
  * Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

  **Nice to have**

  * Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.
  * Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.
  * Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.
  * PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.
  * Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.

title: AI Engineer (Agents & Systems)
description:
**About The Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled and communicative AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications. This is a hybrid role that demands deep technical expertise in modern AI ecosystems alongside exceptional communication skills. You will not only build complex, production\-ready AI systems but also serve as a key technical liaison—translating complex AI concepts for clients, gathering requirements, and producing crystal\-clear technical documentation.

If you are just as comfortable writing complex orchestration logic for LLMs as you are leading a client presentation in flawless English, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Development \& Engineering:**

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent systems, and generative AI applications from scratch.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines tailored to specific business use cases.
* Optimize AI model performance, latency, and cost within production environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise software and workflows.

**Communication \& Client Facing:**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients, leading meetings to gather requirements, scope projects, and present technical solutions clearly and confidently.
* Translate business needs into actionable technical architectures and explain complex AI mechanics to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with internal product managers, developers, and leadership to ensure alignment on project goals.

**Documentation \& Process:**

* Create and maintain comprehensive, high\-quality technical documentation, including system architectures, API specifications, and user manuals.
* Draft clear client proposals, progress reports, and post\-deployment handover documents.
* Establish best practices for code quality, testing, and system documentation within the AI engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Skills:**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Software Engineering with at least 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on, proven experience building and deploying AI applications, LLM integrations, or AI agents in production.
* **Programming:** Advanced proficiency in Python and familiarity with Node.js or TypeScript.
* **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with modern AI orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
* **Models \& APIs:** Deep understanding of commercial and open\-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* **Cloud \& Deployment:** Experience deploying scalable applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, utilizing Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

**Communication \& Soft Skills:**

* **Language:** Exceptional proficiency in written and spoken English. Must be able to articulate complex ideas smoothly and professionally.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** Proven track record of interacting directly with clients, managing expectations, and delivering technical presentations.
* **Documentation:** Strong technical writing skills with a portfolio of past documentation (system designs, readmes, whitepapers, or client briefs).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing personal or open\-source contributions to AI agent frameworks.
* Experience with UI/UX prototyping tools (Streamlit, Gradio, or Next.js) to build quick proof\-of\-concepts for clients.
* Previous experience in a consulting, agency, or fast\-paced startup environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
